gloss: to cool oneself, to enjoy the cool

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {涼|すず}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to cool oneself, to enjoy the cool
definitions.explanation: To seek relief from heat by going to a cool place or catching a breeze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{涼|すず}む。
examples.english: Enjoy the cool air on the veranda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{木陰|こかげ}→木陰：05043_kokage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{涼|すず}んでいた。
examples.english: It was hot, so I was cooling off in the shade of a tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕涼|ゆうすず}み→夕涼み：15371_yuusuzumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I went out for a walk to enjoy the evening cool.

notes:
{涼|すず}む means to cool oneself or enjoy cool air, especially during hot summer days.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{涼|すず}む (cool off at X)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{涼|すず}む (to cool off on the veranda)
- ⟦{木陰|こかげ}→木陰：05043_kokage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{涼|すず}む (to cool off in the tree shade)
- ⟦{夕涼|ゆうすず}み→夕涼み：15371_yuusuzumi⟧ (enjoying the evening cool) [noun]

CULTURAL NOTE:
Enjoying the cool breeze ({涼|すず}む) is a traditional Japanese way of coping with hot summers. Activities include sitting on the ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧ (veranda), listening to ⟦{風鈴|ふうりん}→風鈴：09929_fuurin⟧ (wind chimes), or going out for ⟦{夕涼|ゆうすず}み→夕涼み：15371_yuusuzumi⟧ in the evening.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧ (cool, refreshing) [i-adjective]
